tei:div.tei:p: 339) bla grub sdug bsngal mun sel gyi gtor bsngo bzhugs so/ 340) om̐ āḥhūm̐/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi gtor ma dam pa 'di// sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin nus stobs kyis// ji ltar 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i longs spyod mchog /rgya che rgyun mi chad du byin rlabs te// rgyal ba rab 'byams rtsa rgyud bla ma dang*// yi dam zhi khro mkha' 'gro dpa' bo ging*// chos skyong dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// dgyes par bzhes shing thugs dam skongs gyur cig /khyad par rgyal ba sman bla rigs lnga dang*// rgyud pa'i bla ma drang srong rig 'dzin tshogs// yi dam rta mgrin yum chen phag 341) mor bcas// ye shes mkha' 'gro sde bzhi 'khor tshogs 'bum// bka' bsrung chen po rdo rje 'dud 'dul dang*// e ka dzā ṭi gza' mchog rā hu la// mkha' 'gro lce spyang gnod sbyin bshan pa dmar// dam can chen po srin po dgra dur dang*// bdud mo shān ti srog bdag hob le nag /srung ma dam can rgya mtsho sprul 'khor bcas// sman skyong lha mo dkar phyogs gzhi bdag rigs// gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu'i bka' 'khor gyi// chos kyi gter rdzas sman gyi phrin las bdag / 342) gnas yul gzhi bdagam lus thams cad la// zag me dbadud rtsi'i gtor ma rgya chen po// nam mkha' rab 'byams khyab par 'bul lags kyi// so so'i thugs dam gnyan po bskangs nas kyang*// sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs mthar dar zhing rgyas// bstan 'dzin chos mthun sku tshe phrin las 'phel// thos bsam sgom pa'i 'bras bu mthar phyin mdzod// rgyal khams 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad du// nad mug mtshon 'khrugs sad ser phyugs nad dang*/ 'byung ba'i g.yo 'khrug ltas ngan kun zhi zhing*/

/'gro kun bde 'byor dam chos spyod par mdzod// khyad par bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag bcas// 'gal rkyen nyer 'tsho'i kun gzhi mthun rkyen 'phel// ji ltar bsam dgu chos dang mthun par 'grub// 'gro la phan bde rgya cher 'byung bar mdzod// skyabs gnas bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro ma// 343) chos srung gzhi bdag mchod pas mnyes gyur nas// bdag sogs mkha' mnyam tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyang ste// tshe gcig byang chub mchog gi dngos grub stsol// gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni/ sarba dharma pā la i daṃ ba lingta pu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba siddhi pha la pra yatstsha ku ru hūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal ba sman gyi bla ma sprul 'khor dang bcas la gtor 'bul 'dod gsol rgyun khyer ngag 'don du bgyi thabs mdor bsdus ni/ gso rig 'dzin bla ma karma dar rgyas kyi bzhed pa ltar bkod pa dge legs 'phel/ ༈ mchims yul gyi lha gnyan chen po gangs kaha rgyal po'i gsol kha mchod gtor gyi las rim bzhugs so/ khams gsum zil gnon padma 'byung*// zhabs pad spyi bos btud byas nas// gnas bdag dge gnyan 'khor bcas kyi// mchod gtor las rim mdor bsdus bri// 'dir dge bsnyen 343) chen po gangs lha rgyal po'i gsol mchod kyi las rim ji ltar bya ba ni/ gtsang ma'i gnas su yo byad 'dzoms par byas la/ phyed phud gtsang ma la dge bsnyen chen po'i gtor ma bshos bu zlum po che ba zhig gi mtha' skor du bshos phran brgyad kyis bskor ba'i mthar/ ting lo mar me dgu dang mtheb dkyus mtshan pa dkar rgyan gyis mdzes par bya/ de'i g.yon du yum mchog kong btsun de mo'i gtor ma sman bshos che ba gcig la de dang mtshungs pa'i labashos chung bcu gcig gtso bo dang bcu gnyis ni bstan ma bcu gnyis re/ sha mar snying dang zas sna 'o ma chang phud kyis bran zhing mtheb kyu dang bcu gnyis kyi bskor/ g.yas pyogs su las mkhan zhar ba stag long gi bdud bshos zur gsum pa la mtheb kyu bzhi dang 'changs bu bzhis bskor zhing sha khrag gi brgyan pabashams/

gzhan yang*/ gtso 'khor de dag dang chos skyongs srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag spyi dang bye brag thams cad kyi thugs dam bskangs ba'i dam rdzas sman rag gtor tshogs phyi nang gi mchod pa lnga dang*/ phye mar chang phud 'bru sna sogs ji ltar 'byor ba'i longs spyod dang*/ 345) rta g.yag ra lug bya khyi dkar po 'ba' shig pa'i rten 'dzugs/ mdung dar dkar po mda' lnga ldan la sogs kyi spyan gzigs dang*/ bsangs bsur spos sna'i dud dang*/ rnga dung rol mo la sogs gzi brjid bag dro byin chags pa'i bshams bkod tshul ldan byas la/ thog mar bdag bskyed ni/ bsangs dang bskang gso la sogs cho ga rgyas pa gzhan dang 'brel na bdag bskyed kyang de nas 'byung mod na'ang*/ de lta bu dang mi 'brel bar 'di'i sger gsol lta bu byed pa'i tshe na/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang mi ldan na lha srin dam can de la mi 'du bas/ rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs su dpal chen rta mgrin dmar po dbyug to sdig mdzub can/ khro gtum gzi brjid rngams pa'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa ri rab tsam gyi skur lam gyis mos pas bskyed la/ hrīḥ chos dbyings skye med spros dang bral ba las// 'gag med gsal mdangs dbang chen sku ru shar// me dpung klong nas gar dgu'i nyams kyis rol// srid gsum dregs pa 'dul ba'i gnyen po'o// om̐ badzra kro 346) dha ha ya gṛ wā hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka nas yi ge ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros pa las byung ba'i ye shes kyi me chu rlung gsum gyis mchod gtor gyi 'bag rtsogs thams cad sbyang*/ om̐ ā hūm̐/ gsum 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'dod yon lnga'ilongs spyod mgron rigs so so'i thugs dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas zag med bde ba bskyed cing rgya che la rgyun mi chad pa'i dngos por byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa bya'o/ de nas yang bdag bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bur spros pas dge bsnyen chen po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par mos la/

kyai/ rang bzhin grub pa'i gnas mchog dam pa nas// lha mchog dge bsnyen chen po gangs lha rgyal// btsun mo bod khams skyong mdzad bstan ma'i tshogs// bka' yi bstan srung dpal mgon bdun cur bcas// rnal 'byor dad gdung dbyangs kyi 347)spyan 'dren na// dam tshig gnyan por dgongs te gshegs su gsol// badzra sa mā dzaḥ tsitta hring hring dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pas gzhi bdag 'khor bcas sprin 'thibs pa bzhin byon par bsam la/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐/ rin chen gzhal yas 'dod yon phun tshogs nas// padma nyi zla dar zab baṃ chen sogs// so so'i thugs dang mthun pa'i gdan khri la// dgyes par bzhugs nas dam la gnas par mdzod// sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ don dam ye shes dbyings su ro gcig kyang*// snang tshul rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan skyong phyir// lha srin dregs pa'i tshul du sprul mdzad pa'i// gnas bdag 'khor dang bcas la phyag bgyi'o// a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ḥ dge bsnyen chen po yab yum 'khor bcas la// thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas rmad byung ni// rnam lnga'i mchod pa sman raka gtor ma dang*// 348) tshogs kyi longs spyod bza' btung dkar dmar phud// sha khrag rus pa don snying nang khrol rdzas// spyan gzigs rten rdzas 'dod yon ma tshang med// rang rang thugs bzhed ji bzhin 'bul lags na// bzhes nas mnyes tshim phrin las sgrub mdzad gsol// ma hā sarba pu dza kā ma gu ṇa pra ti tstsha hūm̐/ de nas slar yang mchod gsol bstod pas mnga' gsol ba ni/ de yang kun rdzob 'jig rten btags chags kyi lha 'dra'i rigs 'di rnams bsangs bsur gyi dang dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgra la yid chags pa yin pyir de dag gang 'dzoms dang bcas pas 'di ltar gsol bar bya ste/ kyai/ mnga' gsol la mgon po mthu stobs can// 'dir gshegs shig lha mchog 'khor dang bcas// shar kong yul ljon pa'i skyed tshal dbus// mchims ma sang gnas

349) pa'i yul khams su// ri mtho gnyan gangs lha'i rtse mo ru// 'ja' na bun sprin phung 'khrigs pa'i klong*// mkhar rin chen ba gam lcog gis mdzes// gnas pho brang lha yi gzhal yas na// yab gangs lha bzang po lha yi rgyal// yum kong btsun rdo rje bod khams skyong*// 'bangs zhar ba stag long bdud kyi rje// 'khor mgon po tshogs dang sde brgyad sogs// gnas yul lha gzhi bdag sprul 'khor rnams// de ring mchod pa'i mgron du gnyer lags kyi// 'tshubs cho 'phrul rnam 'gyur ma ston par// thugs spro dga' 'dir gshegs dgyes par bzhugs// rdzas bshams pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// gnas gtsang zhing dngas spro yid mthun 'dir// mgron mnyes byed mchod pa bkod mdzes bshams// spos shing sna'i bsangs dud sprin ltar bstibs// 350) phud 'bru bcud gser skyems mtsho ltar bskyil// tshogs gtor ma lha bshos ri ltar spungs// sman rin chen 'bru sna thang ltar brdal// zas dkar mngar sha khrag rdza ltar nyil// lha mgon po 'khor bcas dgyes par rol// rta ngang dkar cang shes rlung gshog can// rgyan rin chen sga srab si li li// g.yag dkar po gangs ri 'gul shes 'dra// rwa 'gying chen rnga rgyas lang ma ling*// khyi dung mdog seng ge mchongs ltar rngams// mgul g.yer kha'i rgyan cha khro lo lo// bya dkar mdzes dar gyi phod bzang lha// skad snyan po'i sgra dbyangs tse re re// lug g.yang dkar bal gyi 'dab zhol can// brjid chags pa'i dung ru g.yas 'khyil mdzes// nor rkang bzhi gces dgu'i rten btsugs la// lha mgon po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// 'phan dar dkar lce dmar rnga phod can// mda' rgod 351) sgro dar sna me long btags// dbyangs snyan pa'i rol mo 'brug ltar ldir// lha gzhi bdag tshogs rnams dgyes par mdzod// khyod 'dod yon 'byor pas ma phongs kyang*// bdag dngos grub 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i phyir// deng mchod gsol 'di ltar bgyis pa'i mthus// don phrin las rnam bzhi grub par mdzod//

kyai/ gnas bdag chen po gangs lha bzang*// mthu stobs nus stsal bsam mi khyab// stong khams kun la dbang bsgyur ba// rdzu 'phrul can la bdag bstod do// sku mdog dkar mdzes 'dzum mdangs can// dar dkar na bza' zhwa dkar gsol// ru dar dkar 'dzin rta dkar chibs// lha 'khor 'bum dang bcas la ltos// res 'ga' gnod sbyin cha lugs sprul// gser mdog dar zab rin chen brgyan// gter bum bsnams shing dngos grub stsol// nor lha 352) 'bum gyi bskor la bstod// res 'ga' klu btsan cha byad mdzad// mi dmar rta dmar mdung 'thogs/ bse khrab rmog gsol 'khor gsum bcas// btsan 'khor 'bum ldan khyod la bstod// re 'ga' bdud kyi rgyal po'i tshul// khro gtum mi nag rta nag zhon// ru mtshon 'phyar zhing dgra gegs sgrol// bdud dmag 'bum gyi gtso la bstod// zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las kun// sgrub phyir rnam 'gyur so sor ston// bstan pa bsrung zhing bstan 'dzin skyong*// chos srung chen po khyod la bstod// bhyoḥ yum mchog kong btsun de mo yang*/ phyi ltar rdo rje bod khams skyong*// khro tshul ral gri nad rkyal 'dzin// drel nag chibs mdzad khyod la bstod// nang ltar nyi ma'i 'od 'gyed la// gzhon mdzes dar dang rin chen brgyan// yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel bsnams// kong rta gro zhun chibs la bstod// 353)gsang bar mkha' 'gro dpal 'bar ma// dmar mo rin chen rus rgyan spras// me long bsnams zhing bya nag chibs// bstan ma'i 'khor dang bcas la bstod// hūm̐/ lha rgyal yab yum bka' nyan ni// las mkhan zhar ba stag long tshe// smug nag dpa' bo stag chas can// mi gcig dmar 'khrug dgra la gzigs// mda' gzhu ral gri mdung bsnams nas// bdud dmag mang po pho nyar 'gyed// dam nyams dgra srog hab thob byed// bdud 'joms drag rtsal can la bstod// gzhan yang dge chen chen po yi// bka' 'khor lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs// bsam mi khyab la mchod cing bstod// gang bcol phrin las kun 'grub mdzod// hūm̐/

gnas yul bdag po lha rgyal gang bzang rje// yum chen rdo rje de mo sman btsun gtso// pho nya zhar ba stag long yang 'khor tshogs// nor bdag gnod sbyin mdzes par bcas la bstod 454)// bstan pa'i spyi srung gtsang ris bdun cu lnga*// bod yul bstan skyong dgon po srid lha dgu /gnas bdag zhing skyong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas la bstod// dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas khyod rnams kyang*// sngon tshe slob dpon padma thod phreng dang*// grub thob chen po 'dzam gling grags pa sogs// rgyal ba rig 'dzin brgyud bcas spyan snga ru// ji ltar khas blangs dam bcas dran mdzod la// rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnyan po bsrung ba dang*// skyes chen rnams kyi sku tshe phrin las spel// dge 'dun mthun zhing chos spyod sgom sgrub brtson// chos mthun dpal dang bde 'byor rgyas par mdzod// 'jig rten khams su nad yams 'khrug rtsod dang*// sad ser mu ge phyug nad 'byung po'i gdon// 'byung ba'i g.yo 'khrug gnod 'tshe'i rigs gyur kun// rtag tu zhi zhing bsrung bar mdzad du gsol// 355) khyad par yul phyogs dgon gnas 'di dag gi /dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas thams cad la// bar chad med cing mthun rkyen phun tshogs pas// chos dang bkra shis dge legs 'phel bar mdzod// gnas bdag chen po yab yum blon 'bangs bcas// thugs dam bskongs nas sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin// rnal 'byor bdag gis ji ltar gsol ba'i don// tshe gcig byang chub 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod// srung ma thams cad mnyes shing tshim nas so so rang rang gi gnas su skad cig la gshegs par gyur/ ya hi gatstsha/ gzhan yang 'dod gsol smon lam shis brjod la sogs ji ltar rigs pa skabs dngasbyar la bya zhing*/ de nas mchod gtor yo byad kyi bye brag la 'bul dang gshegs par 'os pa rnams gshegs/

dngos grub tu blang par 'os pa rnams bsdu'o/ cho ga 'di la gang zhig gsol kha rgyas par byed pa'i skabs su ni la'adi nyid yongs rdzogs mthar chags su bya zhing*/ rgyun gyi bskang gso gtor bsngos sogs kyi 'jug tu khyer 356) byed pa'i tshe na/ ha cang tshigs tshogs mang na dge sbyor sgrig ma gzhan la gnod pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas/ gong gi spyan bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa rnams kyi 'phror 'og gi hūm̐/ gnas yul bdag po lha rgyal gang bzang rje/ zhes sogs 'thud la bya zhing*/ bar gyi mnga' gsol tshan gnyis po bzhag pas cog tshe/ de ltar rgyas bsdus mtshams 'byor shes par bya'o/ 'di ltar gzhi bdag chen po'i gsol mchod kyi las rim mdor bsdus 'di nyid/ dpal ldan 'bri gung sa chen chen pos rjes su bzung zhing byin brlab pa/ shar dga' bla ma ratna ma ṇis bskul bar mdzad pa bzhin/ sna tshogs rang grol gyis rgod phug yang dben du yi ger bkod pa dge'o/ dza yantu/ ༈ bde yangs byang chub gling gi gzhi bdag glu btsan grags pa rdo rje'i gsol kha bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni hūm̐/ gzhi bdag chen po grags pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i mchod bya bar 'dod na/ gtor mchod spyan gzigs sogs rgyas par bshams la/ thog mar bdag lhar bskyed pa dang mchod gtor byin gyis brlab pa'i 357) rim pa mdor bsdus ni/ hrīḥ bdag nyid skad cig dran rdzogs rta mgrin rgyal// dmar gsal gri gug thod khrag thod khro chas brgyan// me spungs klong na rib tsam sku// snang srid thams cad zil gyis gnon par gyur// om̐ badzra kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ༈ thugs ka'i sa bon hrīḥdamar po las mngon par sprul pa'i yi ge ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros pa las byung ba'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul gyi me rlung chu gsum 'phros te mdun du gtor mchod rnams kyi 'bag rtsogs nyes skyon dri ma thams cad sbyangs/

slar yang om̐ āḥhūm̐ gsum spros nas thim pa tsam gyis/ gtor mchod ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la rnam rnam pa 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa bka' srung chos skyong gzhi bdag rnams so sor gang la ci ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab pas stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khyon thams cad gang 358) zhing zag med nam mkha'i mdzod kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes pa'i mthar nam mdzod dang akā ro'i sngags kyi byin brlab bya'o/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ gzhi bdag chen po grags pa rdo rje bar ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul te/ bya rgod sha la 'thibs pa'am glag mo gzan la 'dzum pa ltar skad cig la mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon par gyur// kyai/ dam tshig chen po'i gnas mchog nas// bka' srung grags pa rdo rje 'bar// gdung ba'i dbyangs kyi spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// rang bzhin gnas rnams gar bzhugs kyang*// deng 'dir mchod cing gsol ba'i phyir// rol mo'i sgra dang mnyes pa'i rdzas// legs par bshams te spyan 'dren gyi// rgyal ba rig 'dzin brgyud bcas drung*// khas blangs dam bca' dran mdzod la// phrin las thogs med bsgrub 359) pa'i phyir// skad cig tsam gyis gshegs su gsol/ o ྃtsa ti bu la badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ kye/ mthu stobs rtsal ldan srung ma 'khor bcas rnams// dam tshig mthun pa'i gnas 'dir dgyes par bzhugs// dang ba'i yid kyi phyag 'tshal gus pas 'dud// bdag sogs 'khor bcas bsrung skyobs phrin las mdzod// khyod la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni// phyi mchod rnam lnga dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi/ nad mchod 'dod lnga sman rakā gtor tshogs dang*// gsang ba sbyor sgrol ting 'dzin bla med mchod// thun mong bsangs gsur bskang rdzas rten rdzas rigs// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya ci 'dod mchod// khyad par bstan la sdang byed dgra dgegs kyi// sha khrag dbang po don snying nang khrol dang*// bla tshe srog dbugs bcas pa mchod par 'bul//

360) dgyes par bzhes shing thugs dam bskangs nas kyang*// bdag gi 'dod dgu chos bzhin bsgrubs pa dang*// bar chad dgra gegs ma lus zhi bar mdzod// khyed kyi yum dang sras 'khor bka' 'bangs tshogs// las byed pho nya srid sder bcas rnams kyang*// mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya chen 'di/ kye/ gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// om̐ tsa tri shu la kīrti badzra dzwa lā ya/ ma hā sarba pu dza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ kye/ gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// gzhi bdag gnyan po mnga' gsol lo// btsan rod chen po mnga' gsol lo// 'khor bcas mchod bstod mnga' gsol lo// rang bzhin grub pa'i gnas mchog nas// rdzu 'phrul sprul pa'i pho brang cher// grags pa rdo rje 'bar ba rtsal// srung ma chen po khyod la bstod// bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong mdzad khyod// cha lugs rnam 'gyur ma nges te// res 'ga' btsan rgod 'bar 361) pa'i tshul// rngams brjid gzi mdangs can la bstod// sku mdog dmar zhing bse khrab gsol// mdung dmar bsnams nas rta dmar chibs// nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od lta bu// btsan 'khor 'bum gyi bskor la bstod// res 'ga' zhi ba'i las mdzad phyir// mi dkar rta dkar mdung dar dkar// zla ba rgyu skar bskor 'dra ba// lha btsan 'bum gyi bskor la bstod// res 'ga' drag po'i las mdzad pa// mi nag rta nag mdung nag can// mun pa'i grib so btibs 'dra ba'i// bdud btsan 'bum gyis bskor la bstod// 'dod dgu'i dngos grub ster mdzad pa'i// yum mchog mtsho sman klu 'khor bcas// bar snang 'ja' tshon 'khrigs pa 'dra// klu btsan 'bum gyis bskor la bstod// drag rtsal mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ni// mkha' la glog dmar 'khrugs pa 'dra// gtso 'khor phyag brnyan sprul par bcas// 362) mthu ldan srung ma'i tshogs la bstod// kye/ mchod pa'i yo byad phun tshogs pas// chos skyong chen po mnga' gsol lo// spyan gzigs dkor cha sna tshogs kyis// gzhi bdag chen po mnga' gsol lo// pho brang rten rdzas yid 'ong ba'i// gnas bdag chen po mnga' gsol lo// sman raka gtor tshogs dam rdzas kyis// btsan rgod chen po mnga' gsol lo// gtsang phud dkar gtor rgyan ldan gyi// lha btsan 'khor bcas mnga' gsol lo// sha khrag dmar mchod longs spyod kyis// bdud btsan 'khor bcas mnga' gsol lo// dkar dmar rin chen dar sman gyis// yum mchog klu sman mnga' gsol lo// gang la ci 'dod gtor mchod 'dis// 'khor bcas dgyes par mnga' gsol lo// gsol lo mchod do srung ma'i tshogs// mnyes par bzhes shig mthu ldan rnams// tshim par mdzod cig 'khor bcas kun// thugs dam skongs la phrin las mdzod// slob dpon padma thod phreng dang*// rig 'dzin bka' srung gong ma yi// spyan sngar khas blang dam mnos pa'i//

463) dam tshig nyan las khyed ma 'da'// bdag cag rjes 'jug 'khor bcas kyi// bsam pa'i don kun bsgrub tu gsol// nad gdon rkyen ngan bar chad rigs// chags che mya ngan 'thab 'khrugs bya// blo bur yod 'grog god kha sogs// 'gal rkyen gnod 'tshe bzlog par mdzod// tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang dang*// mi nor zas gos longs spyod g.yang*// snyan grags bde legs yon tan kun// chos dang mthun par 'phel bar mdzod// sangs rgyas bstan dang chos spyod la// gnod pa byed pa'i dgra gegs rnams// srog chod dbugs longs sha khrag zo// ming tsam med par brlag par mdzod// mdor na srung ma chen po khyod// yum sras 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// bdag gi bcol ba'i phrin las kun// thog med myur du sgrub par mdzod// om̐ tsa tri shu la sa ma ya dam las ma 'da' zhig /sarba siddhi pha la pra yatstsha kurawa ntu swā hā/ zhes brjod la mchod gtor phul bas srung ma thams cad dga' mgu yi rangs nas ci bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes shing rang rang gnas su gshegs par dmigs la/ smon lam bkra shis sogs rjes chog thams cad spyi dang mthun par bya zhing dmigs med kyi rgyas gdab par bya'o/ de ltar gzhi bdag grags pa rdo rje 'bar ba'i gsol mchod mdor bsdus 'di ni/ dbon po o rgyan bstan pas bskul bar mdzad pa bzhin/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi rnal 'byor pas yi ger bkod pa dge legs 'phel bar gyar cig hūm̐/ rang bzhin grub pa'i pho brang chen po nas// bdud btsan drag po rdo rje kun dga' 'brug /sngon gyi khas blangs dam tshig dran mdzod la// rdzu 'phrul mthu yis yud tsam gnas 'dir gshegs// om̐ badzra nanda me gha swa ra sa mwa dzaḥ phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka gtor tshogs dang*// spyan gzigs thugs dam skong ba'i yo byad kun// sngags dang ting 'dzin bden pas byin brlabs te// 'bul gyi dgyes par bzhes la phrin las sgrubs// badzra

365)nanda me gha swa ra sarba pu dza khā hi/ hūm̐/ drag rtsal mthu stobs gzi ldan kun dga' 'brug /sku mdog dmar smug sgeg cing dpa' gtum tshul// 'khor gsum rgyan mdung dar zhags pa bsnams// rta nag rting dkar chibs la phyag 'tshal bstod// bdud btsan 'khor tshogs 'bum gyi gtso khyod// rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin// snga 'gyur snying po'i bstan pa bsrung ba la// bsnyel dang g.yel ba med par mdzad du gsol// gtsug lag dge 'dun sde spel mthun rkyen sgrubs// bstan dgra tshar chod bla ma'i sku tshe bsring*// dam chos tshul bzhin spyaud rnams bu bzhin skyong*// phrin las gang bcol thogs med sgrub mdzod cig /badzra nanda me gha swa ra sa ma ya tsitta u sa karma ku ru hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes smin grol bskyed rdzogs gling gi gzhi bdag kun dka' 'brug gi gtor mchod nyung ngu 'di yang*/ chos dbyings 'od gsal rtse mo'i sgom khang du bris pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba dza yantu/
